title: asphodelus albus subsp. subalpinus
intro:
Asphodelus albus subsp. subalpinus, commonly known as Alpine Asphodel, is a sub-species of the white asphodel plant, native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Asphodel include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
